item.title: GitTube weekly digest: week 45, 2026 (2–8 Nov 2026)
item.description:
The best of GitHub this week (2–8 Nov 2026), picked from GitTube's lanes. This entry is refreshed daily until the week ends.

Rising fastest

  1. storytold/craft-anything (Rust) ★ 19,145, +2,680 this day: Craft Anything: understand how any software works, and craft your own.
  2. Gathin23/cleanyourtv (Python) ★ 53,531, +597 this day: Debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home.
  3. Minireel/HGhub (TypeScript) ★ 1,908, +565 this day: YellowFruit third-party client
  4. seedds/nxnative (Python) ★ 13,134, +410 this day: Switch games running natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac: an NSP folder becomes an unsigned IPA (NSO rewriter, Horizon HLE host, NVN→Metal)
  5. KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop (TypeScript) ★ 3,834, +364 this day: 让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。
